title: Vector2.UP and friends
prompt: Return the velocity of the robot moving straight up at the given speed. Godot has ready-made direction vectors, and up means a negative y on screen. Speed 10 gives (0, -10).
hints: A direction of length 1 times a speed gives a velocity.

docs.name: Vector2.UP, DOWN, LEFT, RIGHT, ZERO
docs.what: Ready-made vectors. UP is (0, -1) because y grows downward on screen.

docs.name: a + b, a - b, v * number, v / number
docs.what: Vectors add and subtract part by part, and scale by a plain number.

solution:
func solve(speed) -> Vector2:
	return Vector2.UP * speed
